_about: Guided learning scenarios (docs/plans/2026-11-26-guided-learning-mode.md section 4). detect: how dbc_check --scenarios finds the scenario in a log from the GPS speed reference; null means the log cannot show it was done. roles: the dbc_check results it feeds. The thresholds are first guesses.

scenarios.prompt: Drive straight, 30-60 s at about the same speed, twice at different speeds
Pull away gently and let it shift up through the gears
Parked, engine on: press the brake, release
Parked: press the accelerator gently, rev
